title: EVASIVE_ACTION returns to ATTACK_TARGET on the first update whose float32 frustration exceeds 0.5 s, tick 61
derivation: A Mamba-like ship (max_flight_roll 2.1, max_flight_pitch 1.4) in EVASIVE_ACTION with a stationary ship 5000 m away, accuracy 2, no proximity alert: behaviour_evasive_action sets desired_speed = maxFlightSpeed (4003; no afterburner) and runs evasiveAction (4019). Frustration starts at 0 (reset at tick 0) and gains dt per update in float32 (4021). Contract item 8: the first update at which fround accumulation exceeds 0.5 is the 61st (a float64 sum crosses at 60); it is computed here by loop (firstTickAbove(0.5) = 61, never ceil(0.5 * 120)). At tick 60 the counter is the 60-step float32 sum (at most 0.5) and the behaviour is still EVASIVE_ACTION; at tick 61 it exceeds 0.5 and `behaviour == FLEE_EVASIVE_ACTION` is false, so the behaviour becomes ATTACK_TARGET (4028). The ship accelerates at most 5 * 32 * 61 / 120 = 81 m/s and moves about 20 m of the 5000, and the branch does not read the range, so holding the pose is exact. Counter checks are exact (tolerance 0).
